exposure: appropriateness of weight gain during pregnancy
weight of the second fetus (Fetus2) relative to the first (Fetus1)
cohort: The study included pregnant women carrying twins who received systematic antenatal care and delivered at the Beijing Obstetrics and Gynecology Hospital between January 2017 and March 2019.
finding: A scoring system for vaginal delivery of twin pregnancies was established, where a score greater than 168 significantly increased the success rate of vaginal delivery.
mod_finding: A scoring system was established to guide the selection of mode of delivery, specifically predicting the success of vaginal delivery for twin pregnancies.
